limitations: Same 82 regression candidates, not a new blind test
Automatic PDF/GP pairing does not guarantee identical editions
Audit only verifies slide events when both source and destination bars match core notation
Current rule needs a sl. label, directional line and filled slur between adjacent single notes on one string within one system
Unsupported slide labels are reported but experimental export is not universally blocked by incomplete techniques
Chords, cross-system slides, more font/path forms, other techniques and audible device playback remain incomplete
